supported_claims.text: 請 is analyzed in a historical lexicographic account as a phonosemantic compound: 言 contributes the speech-related meaning category, while 青 supplies the sound. The selected seal-style rendering shows this traditional graph, but is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact.

The modern sound comparison is 青 qīng and 請 qǐng in Mandarin. In the Baxter–Sagart 2014 system, 青 is MC tsheng, OC *[s.r̥]ˤeŋ; 請 qǐng is MC tshjengX, OC *[tsʰ]eŋʔ. These forms support a historical sound relationship, though the modern readings alone do not establish it.
请 is the standardized simplified counterpart of 請, with 讠 as the simplified component corresponding to 言; this is a modern standardization relationship, not evidence of ancient graphic chronology.

The Shuowen gloss 謁也 is a historical lexicographic gloss, not evidence of the earliest attestation. The supplied research did not establish a dated earliest specimen or a sequence of graphic changes for 請.

The 請 dictionary entry records request/entreaty, engagement, invitation, petition, inquiry, greeting and respectful-request uses. The available material does not establish their chronology or semantic links.

limitations.text: No dated ancient specimen sequence was verified, so the dossier supports the reported component analysis but not a claim about when the graph or its components first appeared.
Several readings and distinct dictionary-recorded uses occur under 請, including qīng in 請室 and qíng uses glossed as 通情 and 通擎. Their relationship to the qǐng reading is not established here.
The sound comparison supports the reported phonetic role, but does not independently establish the graph's formation date or a semantic chronology.
